meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed RuntimeAgentToolRegistry bounded lexical discovery, AiClient declaration refresh, Support/Admin integration and agent contract tests against merged About controller.

auth.review_note: Reviewed the backend skill changes and capability boundary against unchanged account/login authorization: anonymous cart/status handles cannot read accounts, saved addresses or private owner records; browser credentials do not authorize remote tools.

commerce.review_note: Cross-reviewed current-price cart paise precision, captured-INR predicate, shared idempotent VerifiedOrderService, actual-discount GST and frozen tax evidence. Order/checkout docs distinguish captured payment from saved order and preserve later browser-cart edits on retry.

content.review_note: Verified editorial profile, factual copy, approved image dimensions, module-filtered links and canonical AboutPage metadata against content guide.

foundation.review_note: Cross-checked views/public/shop.php GET declarative form, native CDP and JavaScript exact discovery in actual Chrome, public contact invocation and the official Chrome form documentation; no runtime change.

google-tags.review_note: Canonical About metadata now uses existing SeoService and configured origin; reporting and tag rendering unchanged.

http-errors.review_note: Cross-checked the explicit Stripe namespace fallback against the existing canonical client and checkout call sites. RequestFailureService registration, CLI failure handling and exact MCP/webhook session bypass remain unchanged. The regression captures the real bootstrap before any fixture preload.

interface.review_note: Measured normal-text contrast on the actual About page, corrected low-contrast secondary token on warm surfaces and retained red/green browser contrast regression across desktop and mobile.

mail.review_note: Reviewed SupportBotService discovery-only change against unchanged mail behavior and docs.

mcp-clients.review_note: Synthetic connection probe is owner/CLI only; no public MCP capability changes.

media.review_note: Reviewed product image paths and the bounded A2UI gallery against current media hosting paths; styling does not move uploads, delete media or expose private asset directories.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed AdminController tool-discovery integration; About merge leaves operator-help routes and guidance intact.

public-mcp.review_note: Role-filtered internal runtime adapter does not register new public MCP methods or broaden external access.

remote-commerce.review_note: Cross-checked shop form GET navigation and existing commerce registrations with exact native and polyfill discovery; no commerce invocation, authorization, checkout or payment semantics changed.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed the sales-channel CLI references and catalogue guidance. This change only fixes generic PHP lint argument forwarding and failure propagation; feed, channel and catalogue operations are unchanged.

workflow.review_note: Added real About browser acceptance before merge and after exact deployed SHA; existing checks retained.
